# CLI reference

The headless surface's own help text, rendered verbatim from the `aeolus-cli` crate's `USAGE` — the single source: the page regenerates from the crate, so the book can never drift from the binary's `--help`. The theme spec, the fail-on modes and the exit-code contract are the text's own sections.

```text
aeolus — Tailwind v4 class compiler, headless surface

USAGE:
  aeolus resolve [--theme <spec>] [--summary] [--json] <classes...>
                                                     plan snapshot JSON (the artifact)
  aeolus css     [--theme <spec>] <classes...>               verification CSS (v4 shapes)
  aeolus diff    [--theme <spec>] [--json] <A> <B>           base-layer diff with lanes
  aeolus cn      <classes...>                                cn() conflict merge
  aeolus check   [--theme <spec>] [--fail-on <mode>] [--json] <files...>
                                                             lint class strings in sources
  aeolus explain [--theme <spec>] <classes...>               per-class Rust tokens (the emit (a) arm)
  aeolus sort    [--json] <classes...>                       registry-order class sort (the §5.5 parity line)
  aeolus fmt     [--check] <file>                            one file's class strings into the canonical order;
                                                             --check prints the drift report and exits 1 (CI gate)
  aeolus expand  [--theme <spec>] [--json] [--dark] [--reduced-motion]
                 [--more-contrast] [--less-contrast] [--forced-colors] [--print]
                 [--pointer-fine] [--pointer-coarse] [--pointer-none]
                 [--any-pointer-fine] [--any-pointer-coarse] [--any-pointer-none]
                 [--portrait] [--inverted-colors] [--noscript] [--starting] [--rtl]
                 [--hover] [--focus] [--focus-visible] [--focus-within] [--active]
                 [--disabled] [--visited] [--checked] [--placeholder-shown]
                 [--group-hover] [--group-focus] [--peer-hover] [--peer-focus]
                 [--group-focus-visible] [--group-focus-within] [--group-active] [--group-disabled] [--group-visited] [--group-checked]
                 [--peer-focus-visible] [--peer-focus-within] [--peer-active] [--peer-disabled] [--peer-visited] [--peer-checked]
                 [--invalid] [--user-valid] [--user-invalid] [--target]
                 [--indeterminate] [--autofill] [--read-write] [--open] [--inert]
                 [--default] [--form-associated] [--required] [--range-bounded]
                 [--range-in] [--container name=rem] [--width rem] [--has kind=fragment]
                 [--supports condition] [--data name[=value]] [--aria name[=value]]
                 [--custom <path.css>] [--child i/n] [--child-of-type i/n] [--empty]
                 [--pseudo <target>] <classes...>
                                                             effective declarations (the interp (c) arm);
                                                             --pseudo resolves the named pseudo-element
                                                             render target's own cascade beside the
                                                             element answer (selection|placeholder|
                                                             before|after|marker|first-letter|first-line|
                                                             file|backdrop|details-content), --container names the bounds the named
                                                             @container layers resolve from, --has carries
                                                             the subtree facts the has-*:/group-has-*:/
                                                             peer-has-*: layers answer from (kind is
                                                             element|group|peer), --child/--child-of-type/--empty
                                                             carry the structural facts the first:/last:/odd:/
                                                             even:/only:/nth-*:/empty:/first-of-type:/last-of-type:/
                                                             only-of-type:/nth-of-type-*:/nth-last-of-type-*: layers
                                                             answer from (the child-index and type-relative
                                                             dimensions are independent answers),
                                                             --width carries the viewport width (rem)
                                                             the sm:..2xl: breakpoint layers and the
                                                             max-*: forms answer from, --data/--aria
                                                             carry the attribute bits the data-*:/
                                                             aria-*: layers answer from (name for
                                                             the presence spelling, name=value for
                                                             the value spelling; the bare aria fact
                                                             asserts the fold's own true reading),
                                                             --custom carries a CSS file's
                                                             @custom-variant/@utility statements
                                                             (the aliases fold onto the typed Cond
                                                             surface, the utilities join the lookup)
  aeolus build   [--theme <spec>] [--out <path>] [--fail-on <mode>] [--json] <files/dirs...>
                                                             one stylesheet for the whole project
                                                             (scan → dedupe → registry-ordered rules
                                                             + the :root/.dark vars block)
  aeolus plan    [--theme <spec>] [--summary] [--json] [--fail-on <mode>] <classes...>
                                                             the V1 lane's plan bridge (§7): the v0.x plan
                                                             the backends consume, as the same snapshot
                                                             JSON `resolve` prints; slot-boundary notes
                                                             and per-class misses report on stderr
  aeolus audit   [--theme <spec>] [--fail-on <mode>] [--json] <files...>
                                                             capability audit (§5.1's project-sized twin):
                                                             per-class longhand tiers against the GPUI
                                                             backend — the refused/polyfill rows name the
                                                             generated table's own boundary reason

THEME: shadcn (default) | shadcn-dark | default | <path-to-css>
       (`explain`/`build`/`plan`/`audit` accept shadcn | shadcn-dark | <path> — the V1 theme pass;
       without --theme, build/plan keep the colour tokens as typed boundaries)
       (`check` reads a --theme CSS path's @source registrations (§5.4): inline
       candidates join the lint, walked paths join the scan set relative to the
       theme CSS's directory, `not` paths prune the registrations — a file the
       operator passed explicitly survives the prune)
FAIL-ON: unknown | unsupported | conflict (check only) | any | none
         audit: refused | polyfill | any | none
         (default: check unknown; build/plan/audit none)
EXIT: 0 success · 1 findings · 2 usage/theme/IO error

```
